user.title: Cheapest Hour Scheduler
user.description: Choose the price sensor (with prices_today / prices_tomorrow attributes) and how many consecutive hours the cheapest block should be.

data_description.price_sensor: Sensor with prices_today and prices_tomorrow attributes, e.g. sensor.zonneplan_current_tariff_rounded
data_description.block_hours: Length of the cheapest consecutive block. Quarters are allowed (e.g. 2.5).

init.title: Settings
init.description: Price sensor and block length. Add, edit or remove devices on the integration page.

data_description.price_sensor: Sensor with prices_today and prices_tomorrow attributes, e.g. sensor.zonneplan_current_tariff_rounded
data_description.block_hours: Length of the cheapest consecutive block. Quarters are allowed (e.g. 2.5).

user.title: Add device
user.description:
Without 'ready by' the device follows the shared cheapest block (plus offset); with 'ready by' it gets its own cheapest window that finishes in time.

Use an entity (with a value at start/end) or an action. If you choose an action and leave the data empty, the form comes back after Submit with the action's example data filled in (like 'Fill example data' in the developer tools): check it, remove what you don't need and submit again.

data_description.name: Shown everywhere instead of the entity name, e.g. 'Dishwasher'.
data_description.entity_id: switch, number, select, button, script, … Leave empty when you use an action.
data_description.on_value: 'on' for switches; a number for number entities; 'auto' (or text containing {seconds_until_start}) sends the number of seconds until the start.
data_description.off_value: Usually 'off'. Leave empty to do nothing at the end.
data_description.action: Service to call at the start instead of setting the entity, e.g. home_connect.start_selected_program.
data_description.action_data: YAML data for the action (what goes under data:). Use {seconds_until_start} or {minutes_until_start} for the time until the planned start; the action is then called ahead of time, like 'auto'. Empty = call without data.
data_description.ready_by: Time the device must be finished. The device then gets its own cheapest window of 'run time' hours (or the block length) that ends before this time, e.g. 07:00. Empty = follow the shared block.
data_description.duration_hours: How long it must stay on. Empty = until the end of the block.
data_description.start_offset_minutes: Start this many minutes after the block starts (only without 'ready by').
